Article 25 (Payment Delay)
① The postal service shall delay payment until the authenticity of the postal order or its details is verified in the following cases:
1. When there is a missing, altered, or changed item on the postal order.
2. When the name of the recipient or other party does not match the information on the postal order.
3. When the amounts indicated on the postal order are different.
4. When the postal order number, date of issuance, name of the issuing post office, and the name of the handling official are unclear.

② When delaying payment as described in paragraph 1, the postal service shall record the fact of the payment delay, the reason for the delay, and the date of the delay on the back of the postal order, sign it, and return it to the recipient or sender who requested the payment.
